title: Novecento
notes: Italo disco rhythms and refined funk harmonies connect studio pop to the band’s jazz roots.

title: Dreamland
notes: A stronger rhythmic attack offsets synthetic dance-pop with prominent guitars and expansive ballads.

title: Shine
notes: Studio-crafted synth-pop blends the quartet with credited saxophone and trumpet parts.

title: Leaving Now
notes: A move into downtempo and house, balancing club singles with understated melodic material.
